headline: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.voteItem: Amend the road study action to start at Kanani Road
meeting.summary: The committee took up Bill 139 and the South Maui Community Plan together.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Bill 139 and the South Maui Community Plan together.[[0:05:29]] The Maui Planning Commission reviewed the bill on May 27, 2025, and recommended approval.[[0:08:20]] The ranch's consultant said the land would be used for recycling, waste processing and light industry.[[0:15:18]] A testifier said his friend, whose land is shown as park in the plan, was never notified.[[0:43:19]] The committee voted 7–0 to start the road at Kanani Road.[[1:36:23]] The committee voted 8–0 to make the MPO the lead agency for the study.[[1:39:25]] The committee voted 8–0 to add a separate action to build the road.[[1:44:13]]
decided: The committee voted 7–0 to start the proposed road study at Kanani Road.
The committee voted 8–0 to make the MPO the only lead agency for the road study and add federal funding.
The committee voted 8–0 to change the study cost and add a separate action to build the road.
meeting.next: The Council must hold a public hearing on Maui before approving the Maui Island Plan change. The project would also need a change in zoning, with final approval by the County Council. Member Cook will take the lead on follow-up for homes left outside the urban growth boundary.
